title: Cure-Speed Reduction of ClearPath Reinstatement Fees
content:
The cure-speed reduction of the reinstatement fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement counts the calendar days from the agreement's suspended date to the posted date of the latest payment on the agreement:

| Days from suspended date to the latest payment | Reduction of the reinstatement fee |
|---|---|
| 14 days or fewer | 25 percent off |
| more than 14 up to 30 days | 10 percent off |
| a later cure, or no payment | nothing |

A latest payment posted before the suspended date counts as no payment. The latest payment is the payment entry on the agreement's billing ledger with the most recent posting date.

**Hypothetical cases, suspended 2025-05-10.**
- Latest payment posted 2025-05-24: 14 days, 25 percent off.
- Latest payment posted 2025-05-25: 15 days, 10 percent off.
- Latest payment posted 2025-06-09: 30 days, 10 percent off; posted 2025-06-10: 31 days, nothing.
- Latest payment posted 2025-04-28, before the suspension: treated as no payment, nothing off.
